markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (51%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
Three-class conformal set [F1], 0/5 neighbor agreement [F5], and JPEG-degraded frozen section warrant deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 51%, Benign 41%, Normal 6%, Invasive 2% | Close split; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate non-invasive classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability, 1% OOD, 12/12 tiles, JPEG-3 [F6] | Passes QC despite JPEG degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent models match top call |
| Similar cases | 0/5 InSitu (4 Normal, 1 Benign; 69%–70% similarity) | Neighbors favor Normal or Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.47, contribution -0.93) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 5, 9, 10) · context · Above-typical (+1.25, contribution -0.85); 8/20 AI check [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.49, contribution -0.37); 0/20 AI check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Slightly low (z -0.31, contribution +0.33); 0/20 AI check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); mitoses and normal lobules (0/20 AI checks) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section and severity-3 JPEG artifacts mimic atypia; all 5 nearest reference cases are Normal or Benign.
- Medial margin (98% score, called clear [F7]) or unsampled deeper levels harbor lesion; cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 7**: Inspect highest-risk tile (region 6) and stroma (region 7) to separate in situ from benign.
2. **Regions 4, 9**: Check medial margin (98% score in region 4) and inferior margin (49% in region 9).
3. **Regions 3, 5, 10**: Review lobules and lymphocytes; consider drafted deeper levels order (stains blocked on frozen section).
